newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Home sees increased profitability for 97.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Home sees increased profitability for 97.

text.p: U.S. Home Corp said Wednesday it expects increased profitability for fiscal 1997, and expects operating margins in the third and fourth quarters to exceed those in the first half of the year.
It also said that while margins remained under pressure, lower selling, general and administrative expenses and increased closings produced a 10 percent increase in earnings in the second quarter.
The company reported fully diluted earnings per share of $0.81 compared to $0.75 for the same period a year ago.

In addition, the company said it has entered the retirement housing market in Detroit by agreeing, with Silverman Homes of Michigan, to develop a retirement community of 300 homes in the Rochester Hills/Auburn Hills area in the suburbs of northern Detroit.
The company said it is "actively seeking joint venture partners" for similar projects in other parts of the country.

The company also said that in 1998, operations will be favorably impacted by sales at its new Cleveland retirement community, Greenbriar at River Valley, where the models and clubhouse will grand open in the first quarter of 1998.
